summary: KISS Round 4 Materials simplification tested end to end (backend + UI, owner and sales). Quick-counts API: shape is correct and, for all 4 keys, each count equals the length of the filtered list. short_for_jobs_ids matches the short list. needs_ordering = short ∪ reorder-suggestions exactly. Short matches Job Detail material-plan shortages across 788 active jobs; the only extra is an inactive material. Invalid key returns 422. Created a TEST material and TEST PO: needs_ordering/on_order/arriving_week moved by +1 and went back after receiving. UI: the 4 quick cards filter the table to exactly the count and set data-active. Clicking again or quick-clear resets. Default and 'More columns' column sets are correct. Search, supplier filter and more-filters work. Row actions (edit/adjust/delete-confirm) open the existing dialogs and row click opens detail. Every Manage menu item works (catalog, locations, transactions, CSV dialog, bulk mode + bar + bulk edit dialog, ABC templates dialog, create dialog). Sales sees no Manage menu, no row actions, no Reorder or Create PO, and cost cells are all '—'. PO tab: open filter is the default; open/received/cancelled/all filters work; columns are right; a late expected date shows red '· late'. Receiving 3 of 8 persisted (shown as 3/8 after the slow reload). ABC order panel, ABC order history toggle, create-PO dialog and PO row click -> /purchase-orders/{id} all work. Material detail: stat cards, status badge (short/reorder/ok matching quick filters), preferred supplier, Cost/Price cards with no 'MWAC', Edit/Adjust buttons, the more-actions menu and all 6 tabs render data. Product Catalog: back link and new labels are present; ABC mock search returned results. Suppliers tab works. Home 'Material problems' card and Jobs material status still load. Regression suite: 113/114 passed. The 1 failure was a data assumption in a test, not a regression; test fixed and now passes. Main issue found: the list 'Low' badge does not agree with the quick filters or the detail badge.

minor.issue: low_stock = available <= reorder_threshold (operations.py:80). With threshold 0, every material with 0 available counts as 'low'. Live data: 498 active materials have low_stock=true but are NOT in needs_ordering. Their detail page shows 'OK' (e.g. a9d6453c-497a-41c8-928c-8d0cfead2c4e 'MP 04494c24', avail 0, thr 0).

Slow and heavy. Full materials list ~5.3s (1.3MB); PO list ~2.6s (3.4MB). Inventory.load() fetches /materials + /purchase-orders + quick-counts on every keystroke and filter change, with no debounce. Under repeated navigation, calls pile up and the full list took >40s once.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Low' badge (low-badge-*) uses m.low_stock and does not match Needs ordering or the detail badge. In live data 500 rows show 'Low' while Needs ordering = 314 (312 of which are short). Material detail shows 'OK' for these same materials. The requirement says the status badge should agree with the quick filters. Fix: make the list badge use the needs_ordering set (e.g. return needs_ordering_ids from quick-counts like short_for_jobs_ids), or the same projected<threshold && threshold>0 rule as MaterialDetail.

After clicking a quick card, the previous rows (e.g. all ~1200) stay on screen for ~4.6s with no loading indicator. materials-loading only shows when the list is empty. Meanwhile the card is active but the rows don't match the count. Same after clear, when the old filtered rows stay until the 5s full list arrives.

integration_issues.flow: PO receive from Inventory PO tab
integration_issues.issue: Receiving works and persists. But the table refresh after a receive reloads materials + all POs (~3-8s), so po-received / po-outstanding look unchanged for several seconds.

issues: Two back links: the header has 'Back to Materials' (catalog-back-to-materials) and the toolbar still has '← Inventory' (catalog-back). Remove one, or rename the second to 'Materials'.

The status select only offers draft/ordered/partially_received/received/cancelled, though open statuses include submitted/confirmed/shipped etc. Badge text uses replace('_',' '), which only replaces the first underscore (pre-existing).

action_items: Make the materials list Status 'Low' badge use the same rule as Needs ordering and MaterialDetail (threshold>0 && projected<threshold), e.g. return needs_ordering_ids from /materials/quick-counts. Right now 498 materials show 'Low' in the list but 'OK' on detail and are not in Needs ordering.
Show a loading indicator (overlay, dimmed rows or spinner near the cards) while a quick filter / filter request is in flight and old rows are still shown.
Debounce material-search, and don't refetch the 3.4MB /purchase-orders list on every materials filter change. Fetch POs only when the PO tab is shown or after PO actions.
Product Catalog: remove the duplicate '← Inventory' back button, or rename it to Materials.
critical_code_review_comments: materials_quick.reorder compares unrounded floats while reorder-suggestions compares round(projected,3). This could disagree at a 1e-3 boundary; round the same way.
list_materials?quick=... runs quick_sets (5 queries) and Inventory.load calls quick-counts separately on every change, so it is computed twice per filter change. Fine for now.
Inventory.jsx is 552 lines with many dialogs inline. Consider extracting the CSV/bulk/edit/adjust dialogs.
Sales still sees PO totals in the PO tab. This is pre-existing (same as before this round); just flagging that cost-gating doesn't cover PO totals.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ux_round1_fixes.py (test_none_means_no_materials now skips cancelled jobs: list_jobs reports cancelled jobs as 'none' by design, even when they have JobMaterial rows; test-created cancelled job JOB-0795 broke the old assumption)

success_rate.backend: 100% (114/114 after test fix; 1 data-assumption test fixed)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; badge consistency + loading-state issues)

Quick-filter results arrive ~4.6s after the click with old rows still shown, so poll the row count until it equals the count. The receive dialog's submit button is receive-submit. rca of the issue: Badge mismatch: Inventory.jsx shows 'Low' from MaterialListItemOut.low_stock (operations.py:80, available <= reorder_threshold, which is true for threshold 0 and available 0). MaterialDetail and the quick filters use threshold>0 && projected<threshold. Two definitions give different answers for zero-threshold, zero-stock materials.
